 La Mina in Conil announces its summer 2027: Celtas Cortos, Califato ¾, La Húngara and Barry B, with tickets on sale on Monday 16
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Clara Belmonte 
 14 Nov 2026, 18:00 
 A 3-minute read 
 El Pantera / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 La Mina in Conil has programmed seven concerts between 16 July and 16 August 2027 : Manu Sánchez opens and Los Caños closes, with Celtas Cortos on Saturday 14 August. 
 Tickets go on sale on Monday 16 November at 12:00 on Ticketmaster , with a separate ticket for each night and no prices published yet. 
 The line-up mixes folk rock, electronic flamenco, flamenco pop and rap : Celtas Cortos and Califato ¾ share the season with La Húngara and the rapper Lorna. 
 Barry B shares the night of Friday 13 August with Puño Dragón , one more stop in a summer in which he is already on the bill at more than ten festivals. 
 La Mina, the concert venue in Conil de la Frontera (Cádiz), now has its programme for summer 2027: seven concerts between 16 July and 16 August , with Celtas Cortos, Califato ¾, La Húngara and Barry B among the names. Tickets go on sale on Monday 16 November at 12:00 on Ticketmaster, according to the promoter Grupo Concert Tour.
 La Mina's seven concerts in 2027
 Each concert is a separate event, with its own ticket. These are the dates and start times listed on the ticketing site:
 Friday 16 July, 22:00: Manu Sánchez.
 Saturday 31 July, 22:00: Califato ¾.
 Friday 6 August, 21:30: Lorna.
 Saturday 7 August, 21:30: La Húngara.
 Friday 13 August, 21:30: Barry B and Puño Dragón .
 Saturday 14 August, 21:30: Celtas Cortos.
 Monday 16 August, 21:30: Los Caños.
 August accounts for six of the seven nights, almost all on Fridays and Saturdays. Only Los Caños falls on a Monday. The rest of the events for those months are in the festival listings for July and August .
 Tickets: Monday 16 November at 12:00
 Sales open for all seven concerts at the same time on Monday 16 November at 12:00 , Spanish mainland time, on Ticketmaster. Neither the promoter nor the ticketing site has yet published the price for any night, and there is no pass for the whole season: each concert is bought separately.
 These are the links for each night: Manu Sánchez , Califato ¾ , Lorna , La Húngara , Barry B and Puño Dragón , Celtas Cortos and Los Caños . ModoFestival may receive a commission if you buy through these links, at no extra cost to you. Until midday on Monday, the pages do not allow purchases.
 From the folk rock of Celtas Cortos to the electronic flamenco of Califato ¾
 The programme does not stick to a single style. Celtas Cortos is the folk rock band from Valladolid that formed in the 1980s. Califato ¾ blends flamenco and electronic music, and La Húngara comes from flamenco pop.
 The night of 6 August is given over to rap. La Ganzúa's listings identify this Lorna as L0rna , the rapper from Cartagena who debuted in 2025 with the album Miss-Understood , and not the Panamanian singer of "Papi chulo".
 Califato ¾ at Brisa Festival 2025. Image: Pedro J Pacheco / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) La Mina already hosted concerts last summer: the Seville rapper Haze performed there on 26 July 2026. Grupo Concert Tour, which is selling the 2027 season, also sells on its website the dates of Concert Music Festival in Sancti Petri, Chiclana, where David Bisbal and Camilo , among others, will appear next summer.
 Barry B and Puño Dragón, Friday 13 August
 Barry B , the project of Gabriel Barriuso from Burgos, shares Friday 13 August with Puño Dragón , the Asturian alternative rock band. Barry B is already on the bill at more than ten festivals in 2027, as we reported in our round-up of where to see Siloé and Barry B in 2027 . Puño Dragón are also on several line-ups next summer.
 Sources: Grupo Concert Tour website and Ticketmaster, consulted on 14 November 2026; La Ganzúa listings (concerts in Conil de la Frontera and news item of 25 July 2026 about Haze).
